interface.longDescription: A central AMSoft plugin for reviewed agentic workflows. It bundles goal-gated control-plane coordination; provenance-backed software delivery and evidence synthesis; demographic trend-to-product research and design briefs; exact-payload, decoder-verified QR code generation with safe themed backgrounds; protected YouTube media workflows; bounded read-only Reddit browsing through the host's Chrome/CDP surface; truthful restaurant marketing; instruction-only David Jones customer-service till guidance; uncertainty-aware calorie and macro tracking; WordPress project/site management, content-as-code synchronization contracts, checksum-guarded writes, and WordPress SEO operations; business, writing, image editing, protected cloud and Excalidraw operations; and authenticated-encrypted configuration transfer.
